court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Satishchandra Purshottam Kale vs Anjusha Satishchandra Kale And Anr

parties.respondent_defendant: Anjusha Satishchandra Kale And Anr (wife and another)

facts_of_case: Parties agreed to settlement and executed consent terms. Petitioner has produced demand draft in the sum of Rs.10,00,000/- and agreed to deposit further amount of Rs.15,00,000/- by 10th August, 2022.

legal_principles.principle: The terms of agreement between the parties should be fulfilled within a specified period.
legal_principles.held: The terms stipulated in the consent terms are to be fulfilled by both the sides within period of three months from today.

legal_principles.principle: A party may withdraw an amount as part payment towards permanent alimony after the amount is deposited by the other party.
legal_principles.held: The aforesaid amount of Rs.25,00,000/- is permitted to be withdrawn by the Respondent Anjusha Satishchandra Kale after the said amount is deposited by the petitioner as and by way of part payment towards the permanent alimony.

outcome.final_order: Petitioner permitted to deposit demand draft in the registry of this Court along with this order. Petitioner agreed to deposit further amount of Rs.15,00,000/- by 10th August, 2022.
